name: O365_Suspicious External Teams Chat from Known Tenant
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: O365_Suspicious External Teams Chat from Known Tenant
// Vendor: Microsoft 365
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with O365_Suspicious External Teams Chat from Known Tenant.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: INFILTRATION
// ============================================================
// SANITIZED: Environment-specific values replaced with generic placeholders.
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0001 - Initial Access
// Technique: T1566.003 - Phishing: Spearphishing via Service

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = saas_audit_logs

// Eventos de criação de chat no Teams
| filter operation_name_orig = "ChatCreated"

| alter
    workload = json_extract_scalar(raw_log, "$.Workload"),
    communication_type = json_extract_scalar(raw_log, "$.CommunicationType"),
    participant_info = json_extract(raw_log, "$.ParticipantInfo"),
    members = json_extract(raw_log, "$.Members"),
    user_id = json_extract_scalar(raw_log, "$.UserId")

| filter workload contains "Teams"
| filter communication_type = "OneOnOne"

// Campos relevantes do Teams
| alter
    HasForeignTenantUsers = json_extract_scalar(participant_info, "$.HasForeignTenantUsers"),
    HasGuestUsers = json_extract_scalar(participant_info, "$.HasGuestUsers"),
    HasUnauthenticatedUsers = json_extract_scalar(participant_info, "$.HasUnauthenticatedUsers"),
    ParticipatingDomains = json_extract(participant_info, "$.ParticipatingDomains"),
    ParticipatingSIPDomains = json_extract(participant_info, "$.ParticipatingSIPDomains"),
    RequestDomain = arrayindex(regextract(user_id, "^.@(.)$"), 0),
    user1 = json_extract_scalar(members, "$.0.UPN"),
    user2 = json_extract_scalar(members, "$.1.UPN"),
    display_name = json_extract_scalar(members, "$.0.DisplayName")

// Domínio externo suspeito
| filter identity_name contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_24>"
    or to_string(ParticipatingDomains) contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_24>"
    or to_string(ParticipatingSIPDomains) contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_24>"

| fields
    _time,
    caller_ip,
    identity_name,
    operation_name_orig,
    workload,
    communication_type,
    RequestDomain,
    HasForeignTenantUsers,
    HasGuestUsers,
    HasUnauthenticatedUsers,
    ParticipatingDomains,
    ParticipatingSIPDomains,
    user1,
    user2,
    display_name,
    raw_log
description: Detecta a criação de conversas individuais no Microsoft Teams envolvendo usuários pertencentes ao tenant externo `<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_24>`. A regra monitora comunicações OneOnOne originadas ou envolvendo esse domínio, permitindo identificar possíveis tentativas de phishing, engenharia social ou abordagem maliciosa por meio de tenants externos do Microsoft 365.
alert_name: O365_Suspicious External Teams Chat from Known Tenant
alert_description: Foi identificada a criação de uma conversa individual no Microsoft Teams envolvendo um usuário associado ao tenant externo suspeito <INTERNAL_DOMAIN_24>. A comunicação envolveu $user1 e $user2 , com origem no endereço IP $caller_ip . O SOC deve validar a legitimidade da comunicação e verificar possíveis indícios de phishing, engenharia social ou tentativa de interação maliciosa com usuários internos.
